name: Masterfont
description: Long-established Tel Aviv Hebrew type foundry (founded 1984 per MyFonts; 1986 per Fonts.com) owned by Piki and Zvika Rosenberg, with a large Hebrew and Latin library including the Aharoni MF family.
notes: Founding year differs between sources (1984 vs 1986). Official site returned 503 at verification time. On 2026-10-18 www.masterfont.co.il returned 404 and the bare domain failed TLS; activity not re-checked.
